name: Green Belt
summary: The Green Belt is a wild stretch of marshland in the eastern Wetlands, sprawling below the ridges of Grim Batol. It is overrun by roaming bog beasts, predatory crocolisks, and toxic oozes, guarded primarily by the solitary night elf Rethiel the Greenwarden.

sections.title: A Wild and Contested Fen
sections.body: Stretching across the eastern interior of the Wetlands, the Green Belt is one of the sodden region's untamed hollows. The local wildlife—ranging from massive crocolisks to shifting oozes and shambling bog beasts—makes travel through the mossy waters hazardous. Deep within its reaches sits a solitary watch post manned by Rethiel the Greenwarden, a lone night elf dedicated to studying the fen's ecology and keeping its hostile denizens in check.

sections.title: Remnants of the Second War
sections.body: Scattered amidst the muck lies the wreckage of a Dragonmaw clan caravan, left behind after the catastrophic battle at nearby Grim Batol. Crimson whelplings still linger around the broken carts and crushed cages, haunting reminders of the orcish clan's past enslavement of Alexstrasza and her red dragon brood.

faq.q: Where is the Green Belt located?
faq.answer: The Green Belt occupies the eastern half of the Wetlands, lying along the soggy lowlands between the main road and the foothills rising toward Grim Batol.

Rethiel is an enigmatic night elf standing watch in the Wetlands marsh. Far from his ancestral home of Kalimdor, he seeks to preserve nature's balance in the swamp and enlists travelers to deal with corrupting beasts and oozes.

faq.q: Why are there red whelps and broken wagons here?
aliases: why are there whelps in wetlands
faq.answer: They are the ruins of a Dragonmaw clan supply caravan caught in the aftermath of the Second War, when the orcs were routed from Grim Batol and their hold over the red dragonflight shattered.

faq.q: What threats wander the Green Belt?
faq.answer: Travelers through the belt frequently encounter dangerous wetland crocolisks, toxic living oozes, and towering bog beasts that blend seamlessly into the sodden vegetation.

angles.text: Finding Rethiel the Greenwarden stationed alone in an Eastern Kingdoms swamp is an unexpected sight, serving as a reminder of the Cenarion circle and night elven devotion to healing wild lands wherever they lie.
The twisted oozes and unchecked bog beasts of the fen disrupt the natural harmony of the marsh, making the region a point of concern for keepers of the wild.
